purpose: Controlled component ablation of BioNutriGPT Stage 2 counterfactual optimization engine to determine the engineering value of model-score objective, dietary-change penalty, barrier penalty, joint projection, and sequential filters.

model_binding.cutoff_provenance: Fixed 0.5 descriptive research routing; not a clinically selected or validated intervention threshold.

statistical_specification.disclosure: Pilot statistics are engineering checks, not population evidence.

repair.design: Same six variants and frozen participants; execution/verification repair after pilot inspection.
repair.order: Rotate sorted six variants by participant position modulo six; counts per position differ at most one.
repair.timing: Sequential CUDA-synchronized wrapper time excludes model loading, untimed forward warmup and verification; CPU threads=min(12,logical CPUs).
repair.statistics: Primary overall-acceptance exact tests: Holm family 5. Secondary numerical/score-gate exact tests: Holm family 10. Continuous paired bootstrap intervals exploratory, unadjusted; missing execution outputs halt the study, not zero-imputed.
repair.limitations: Filters 1-3 ablated jointly; does not establish each individual filter effect. No universal redundancy claim. Shared preprocessing and numerical validator, separate statistics formulas.
repair.device_required: cuda for planned run; CPU fallback requires explicit protocol revision
